It’s time for a Porsche GT3 RS generations drag race! 

We’ve got Mat lining up in the 996, and alongside him we have a 997.2, a 991, and a 992.1, and we’re about to race them all up a runway to see just how the GT3 RS has evolved since it was first released in 2006! 

All four cars are rear wheel drive, and all are powered by naturally aspirated flat six engines. But will it be an easy win for the newer 992.1? Let’s take a closer look at the stats…

The 996 generation is powered by a 3.6-litre flat six that generates 381hp and 385Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox, and it’s the lightest car here at 1,360kg. In 2026 the car is worth around £180,000.

title: I DRAG RACE every Porsche 911 GT3 RS
